elements.name: 1. Bottom sheets instead of new pages ("lap")
elements.seen_in: Revolut Business transfer detail as a sheet with round X close, status rows, 'Statement: Download', 'Transfer tracking 1 of 3' (revolutbiz_04.jpg) and the 'Business accounts' sheet (revolutbiz_03.jpg); iOS 26 Apple Cash amount sheet (apple_02.jpg); Qonto payment-link / payment-method panels (qontoweb_10.jpg).
elements.what_it_does: Secondary detail slides up over the current screen (grabber, rounded top, dimmed scrim). Context stays visible, one swipe or the round X closes it, navigation stays one level deep. In Revolut 2025-26 nearly every detail is a sheet.
elements.use_in_c: Four sheets: (1) 'Hogyan jött ki?' tax breakdown (TB-járulék 113 220 + Szocho 79 560 + SZJA-előleg 264 600 = 457 380 Ft), opened from a tonal pill under the big amount on the band; (2) the three transfers with their 'Másolás' buttons + közlemény; (3) the 'Befizettem' confirmation; (4) Bence's request ('Kivonat feltöltése'). White sheet, 20 px top corners (the letter keeps 4 px), 36x5 grabber #C5CEDD, scrim --tintakek @40%, medium detent ~60% / large on drag, round 36 px tonal (#D6E0F0) X top-right with aria-label 'Bezárás'. Spring ~0.45 s, no bounce. Web (720 px column): same content as a centred dialog.
elements.risk: Low: sheets are the iOS 26 / Android default, so they read native, not templated. Only risk is overuse; keep real pages for the 4 tabs and the item detail (05).

elements.name: 2. Floating pill tab bar + separate round 'Fotózás' button
elements.seen_in: Revolut Business current store shots (v6.17, Nov 2026): floating capsule tab bar Home/Cards/Transfers/Merchant/Treasury over content (revolutbiz_02.jpg); iOS 26 Phone app: Liquid Glass tab bar with a separate round search button (apple_04.jpg); iOS 26 guidance: tab bar floats, can minimise on scroll, glass only on the navigation layer (donnywals.com, Apple newsroom).
elements.what_it_does: The bar floats above the bottom edge as a capsule, content scrolls under it, and the single most frequent action sits in its own circle next to it. Labels collapse while scrolling down.
elements.use_in_c: Replace the full-width white bar: white capsule (radius 999, ~62 px tall, 16 px side margin, 12 px above home indicator) with 'Főoldal, Dosszié, Üzenetek, Fiók'; active tab = tonal capsule #D6E0F0 behind icon+label, ink #17284A 700. To the right a separate 62 px round ink-blue (#17284A) button with the camera icon (accessible name 'Fotózás'). Material: white 88% + backdrop-blur 20 + hairline #D6DCE5 + shadow 0 6 20 rgba(23,40,74,.12); no refraction/glass shine on a paper app. Selection haptic on tab change; labels hide on scroll-down, return on scroll-up.
elements.risk: Medium: floating bars are the 2025-26 default (looks current), a camera FAB is common. Keep ink-blue not neon, keep text labels (non-tech users), never icon-only.

elements.name: 3. Deadline Live Activity / lock-screen countdown
elements.seen_in: iOS 26 Live Activity: flight card with progress arc, times and gate on the lock screen (apple_01.jpg); Revolut HU 'Közelgő fizetés, 2 napon belül esedékes' (revolut_hu_06.jpg) and Pockets 'Határidő: jún. 25, 4 hónap van hátra' (revolut_hu_07.jpg); Android 16 Live Updates is the Android equivalent.
elements.what_it_does: A time-bound job lives on the lock screen / Dynamic Island with a progress line from start to deadline, updates without opening the app, and ends itself when done.
elements.use_in_c: From 5 days before the NAV deadline (after Bence's letter): ink-blue Live Activity — Bence's small photo, 'NAV-befizetés', '457 380 Ft' (Caslon Condensed tnum), right 'még 3 nap'; underneath a thin line from 'okt. 2. levél' to 'okt. 12. határidő' with a dot for today. Dynamic Island compact 'NAV 3 nap'; expanded adds a 'Befizettem' button (deep-link to the confirmation sheet). After confirmation: green check 'Befizetve, okt. 9.' then auto-dismiss after 1 h. Android: ongoing Live Update notification with the same content.
elements.risk: Low and distinctive (rare in Hungarian apps). No red urgency; amber #8A5A00 only on the last day.

elements.name: 4. Home-screen and lock-screen widgets
elements.seen_in: iOS 26 clear/tinted widget home screens (apple_05.jpg); Qonto iOS widget for fast transfers (qonto.com/es blog) and Qonto Q3 2026 customisable home with resizable widgets (qonto.com/it/product-drop-q3-2026); Revolut 10 widgets.
elements.what_it_does: Glanceable status without opening the app; one tap deep-links into the right screen.
elements.use_in_c: Small (2x2): ink band 'Októberben', '457 380 Ft', 'okt. 12-ig'. Medium (4x2): adds Bence's open request ('Kérem a szeptemberi kivonatot') and a 'Fotózás' deep-link. Lock-screen circular accessory: ring of days left ('3 nap'). Ship a monochrome glyph version so it survives iOS 26 clear/tinted modes; no signature in widgets.
elements.risk: Low. Keep text minimal; it must not look like a wealth/balance widget.

elements.name: 5. Document camera with edge detection
elements.seen_in: Qonto receipt scanner: full-bleed camera, framed receipt, big white shutter (qontoweb_03.jpg, qonto_06.jpg); Ramp camera with flash and gallery (ramp_1.jpg); Revolut Business receipt capture (revolutbiz_06.jpg); Mercury 'Uploading Receipts… 1/3' (mercury_2.jpg).
elements.what_it_does: Camera opens instantly, finds the paper edges, snaps a frame to the corners, auto-captures when steady, flattens/crops, supports multi-page with a counter.
elements.use_in_c: 'Fotózás' screen = the only fully dark screen (#0F1B33). Four white corner brackets animate from screen corners to the detected paper corners (≈200 ms spring) and tint green when steady; hint chip on top 'Tartsd a telefont a papír fölé' → 'Megvan, ne mozdulj'; 72 px white shutter ring; left 'Galéria', right 'Vaku'; page pill '2. oldal' + tonal 'Kész'. Auto-capture after ~0.8 s steady. Haptics: light on edge lock, success on capture. Build on VisionKit / ML Kit document scanner.
elements.risk: Low-medium: standard pattern. Avoid fake 'AI scanning' laser lines or sparkles.

elements.name: 6. 'Megkaptam' match card with read-out fields
elements.seen_in: Revolut Business 'Marrow, Today 05:43, Match found' card floating over the receipt (revolutbiz_06.jpg); Qonto 'Invoices matched' with green check (qontoweb_06.jpg) and extracted-field chips 'Amount ✓ / Account No ✓ / Auto-generated entries ✓' (qonto.com/en/accounting); Dribbble match-confidence banners (dribbble_03.jpg).
elements.what_it_does: Right after capture the app shows what it read and where the document went, so the user trusts the automation without opening anything.
elements.use_in_c: After upload a white card drops in at the top: document icon with green badge, 'Nyugta, 18 000 Ft', 'Az októberi bevételedhez került'. Below, three chips appear with 120 ms stagger: 'Összeg: 18 000 Ft', 'Dátum: okt. 3.', 'Szabó Katalin e.v.' each with a green check; if unreadable an amber chip 'Dátum: nem olvasható, Bence megnézi'. The state word stays 'Feltöltve' until Bence reviews, then 'Bence látta'.
elements.risk: Medium: auto-extraction chips can feel AI-made. No sparkle icon, no word 'AI'; always say Bence checks it.

elements.name: 7. Bence's review card (named human + concrete count)
elements.seen_in: Qonto 'Sarah Lawrence, Bookkeeping access' card with VAT chips above the scanned receipt (qonto_06.jpg); Qonto 'Tania Kosters, Accountant Access, 148 entries verified, Export Data' (qontoweb_05.jpg); Dribbble review history Prepared/Reviewed/Returned/Approved with names (dribbble_02.jpg).
elements.what_it_does: Shows a real person with a face next to the work they did and a concrete number: trust from accountability, not from badges.
elements.use_in_c: Top of Dosszié and in each closed month: white card, Bence's 44 px photo, 'Bence átnézte az októberi iratokat', big Caslon '12 tétel', line 'mind rendben, 1 kérdése van', blue KB monogram on the right; tonal button 'Megnézem a kérdést'. In the Fotózás flow a small pill on top: photo + 'Bence nézi át'.
elements.risk: Low, it is C's core promise. Must be the accountant's real photo, never an illustrated avatar.

elements.name: 8. 'Befizettem' confirmation moment
elements.seen_in: iOS 26 Apple Cash sheet: big amount and one dark pay button (apple_02.jpg); Monarch 'Marked as Reviewed' stamp (monarch_1.jpg); Revolut transfer status tracking (revolutbiz_04.jpg). Anti-example with 3D coins/flames: dribbble_01.jpg.
elements.what_it_does: Turns the most anxious action (paying the tax) into a clear, calm closure: one confirmation, then a visible 'done' state.
elements.use_in_c: 'Befizettem' → sheet 'Mind a hármat elutaltad?' listing the three amounts, primary 'Igen, befizettem', text button 'Még nem'. On confirm: an ink line draws through '457 380 Ft' on the band left→right (≈320 ms, like clearing a ledger entry), below fades in green check + 'Befizetve, okt. 9. 10:24'; Bence's KB monogram stamps once onto the letter corner (scale 1.15→1, 180 ms). Success haptic; the Live Activity ends. Reduced motion: final state only.
elements.risk: Low if it stays ink + green. No confetti, coins, emoji or sound fanfare.

elements.name: 9. Signature drawing itself when the letter opens
elements.seen_in: Revolut 'Customise your cards' with a handwritten signature as card art (revolut_07.jpg); C's own stroke paths (kezjegy_utak.js, kezjegy.py with speed-dependent width).
elements.what_it_does: A single human gesture in motion: proves a person signed this month's letter.
elements.use_in_c: First open of each monthly letter: greeting + two lines fade in (200 ms), then Bence's signature draws in real pen order via stroke-dashoffset (≈900 ms, ease-out), pen-blue #2546A6 on white only. Plays once per letter id; later visits static. prefers-reduced-motion → static. Optional 3-4 light haptic ticks, off by default.
elements.risk: Low, unique to C. Becomes a gimmick if replayed every visit.

elements.name: 10. Round tonal quick-action row
elements.seen_in: Revolut: four labelled round buttons under every balance ('Pénzfeltöltés, Átvezetés, Információ, Továbbiak' – revolut_hu_02.jpg, revolut_02.jpg, revolutbiz_02.jpg); Qonto home: Share IBAN / Upload receipt / Make transfer / Create invoice (qontoweb_01.jpg) and user-customisable 1–4 shortcuts (Qonto help center).
elements.what_it_does: The 3-4 most common jobs always sit in the same place as big round targets with words under them, impossible to mistake for list rows.
elements.use_in_c: Under the letter on Főoldal (and atop Dosszié): 'Fotózás', 'Feltöltés', 'Kérdezek', 'Igazolás'. 56 px circles #D6E0F0, 24 px hand-drawn ink icons (1.7 stroke), labels Archivo 600 13 px; pressed #C3D0E8 + scale .96. Never on the dark band (band rule: no buttons). Directly answers the owner's 'buttons blend in' complaint.
elements.risk: Medium: it is Revolut's signature; keep it tonal ink (not dark glass), C's icons, max 4.

elements.name: 11. Status badge on the icon corner + status pill
elements.seen_in: Revolut automations with a small green check badge on the icon corner (revolut_08.jpg, revolut_hu_07.jpg); Qonto status pills 'Scheduled' (blue clock), 'Paid' (green check), 'To be reviewed' (amber triangle), green amount pill (qontoweb_08.jpg, qontoweb_04.jpg).
elements.what_it_does: State is readable at a glance without reading the line.
elements.use_in_c: Dosszié rows: 40 px tonal circle with the document icon; 16 px badge bottom-right with 2 px white ring (green filled check = Feldolgozva/Beadva; grey clock = Feltöltve/Bence látta). Text keeps the word first ('Feldolgozva, hétfőn'). Item header (05): the same four words as a pill (#E2EFE6 + #2B6744 done; #EEF1F6 + ink waiting).
elements.risk: Low.

elements.name: 12. Pen-hatched 'expected' part in meters and charts
elements.seen_in: Qonto budget bar: solid spent + diagonal-hatched pending, with Reject/Accept (qontoweb_09.jpg); Qonto cash-flow forecast: actual solid, forecast hatched (qontoweb_12.jpg).
elements.what_it_does: Separates fact from estimate without a new colour.
elements.use_in_c: Határ-mérő 'Még 11 580 000 Ft-ot számlázhatsz ÁFA nélkül': solid ink = invoiced so far, then 45° pen hatching (1.5 px ink lines, 4 px gap) = 'várható év végéig' at current pace, tick at 80%; if hatching crosses 80% the sentence turns amber. Same hatching for 'Novemberben várhatóan kb. 190 000 Ft'.
elements.risk: Low; hatching echoes pen on paper and fits C better than gradients.

elements.name: 13. Countdown deadline row (in-app)
elements.seen_in: Revolut HU 'Közelgő fizetés, 2 napon belül esedékes' (revolut_hu_06.jpg), 'Határidő: jún. 25, 4 hónap van hátra' (revolut_hu_07.jpg); Cleo big 'debt-free date May 2028' (cleo_1.jpg).
elements.what_it_does: Plain-language time left instead of a bare date.
elements.use_in_c: When nothing is due: one white row under the band 'Következő befizetés: november 12.' with right-aligned 'még 34 nap'; in deadline week 'még 3 nap' in ink 700. Never red.
elements.risk: Low.

elements.name: 14. Segmented period switch
elements.seen_in: Revolut HU '1 hét / 1 hó / 6 hó / 1 év' (revolut_hu_08.jpg); Qonto 3/9/12 instalment segments and Credit/Debit toggle (qontoweb_11.jpg).
elements.what_it_does: Changes the time frame in place, one tap.
elements.use_in_c: Limits card: 'Havi | Negyedéves | Idei'; Dosszié: 'Október | Szeptember | Korábbi'. Track #EEF1F6, selected = white capsule, ink 700, hairline; 40 px tall.
elements.risk: Low.

elements.name: 15. Requests and payments as chat bubbles
elements.seen_in: Revolut chat transfers with amount bubbles and 'Kérés / Küldés' (revolut_hu_04.jpg, revolut_06.jpg); iOS 26 Apple Cash request bubble with 'Pay' (apple_02.jpg).
elements.what_it_does: The action lives inside the conversation where the request was made.
elements.use_in_c: In Üzenetek Bence's request is a rich bubble: 'Szeptemberi bankszámlakivonat', 'Bence kérte, okt. 2.', tonal 'Feltöltöm' inside. Monthly tax as a bubble 'Októberi befizetés 457 380 Ft' + 'Megnézem' (opens transfer sheet). After action it updates to green 'Feltöltve' / 'Befizetve'.
elements.risk: Low.

elements.name: 16. Yes/no questions you only approve
elements.seen_in: Copilot Money 'Transactions categorized / Refunds caught / Budgets updated – You just approve' + 'Approve all' (copilot_2.jpg); Qonto Reject/Accept pair (qontoweb_09.jpg); Ramp Approve / Request changes (ramp_2.jpg); Qonto AI assistants 'always ask for approval' (Q3 2026 product drop).
elements.what_it_does: Reduces client work to one tap per decision.
elements.use_in_c: Card with Bence's photo: 'Ez a 18 000 Ft-os nyugta a vállalkozásodhoz tartozik?' [Igen] tonal, [Nem, magánkiadás] text button. Max 3 at once; answered ones collapse to a green line.
elements.risk: Medium: 'smart suggestions' read as AI. Phrase as Bence's question, never 'AI javaslat'.

elements.name: 17. Swipe review with an ink stamp
elements.seen_in: Monarch 'Review transactions with a swipe', 'Marked as Reviewed' card (monarch_1.jpg).
elements.what_it_does: Fast triage of many small decisions.
elements.use_in_c: Optional month-end 'Átnézés' for unclear bank lines: stack of white slips; right = 'Üzleti', left = 'Magán', each lands with an ink stamp mark (medium haptic). Buttons always present for accessibility.
elements.risk: Medium-high: gamified, may feel playful for tax; use only if Bence really needs client categorisation.

elements.name: 18. Pen-drawn empty states (generated, then hand-cleaned)
elements.seen_in: Qonto in-app illustrations: thin black line, one pastel fill (empty mailbox qontodribbble_01.jpg, card sleeve qontodribbble_02.jpg).
elements.what_it_does: Turns empty screens into a calm invitation to act.
elements.use_in_c: Three empty states as fountain-pen line art (1.6 px #17284A, round caps, slight wobble) with ONE tonal fill #D6E0F0: empty Dosszié = open folder with paperclip ('Még nincs iratod ebben a hónapban. Fotózd le az első számlád.' + primary 'Fotózás'); all done = sealed envelope with KB monogram ('Minden beadva, nincs teendőd.'); no messages = letter tray. Draft with Recraft V4 Vector via OpenRouter (SVG, no text), then clean to C's stroke by hand.
elements.risk: Medium: isometric Qonto style is recognisable; keep C's front-facing pen style, no people, no mascots.

elements.name: 19. Emphasised primary action (Material 3 Expressive)
elements.seen_in: Google M3 Expressive research: 46 studies, 18 000+ participants, key element found up to 4x faster with bigger coloured button (material_03.jpg, material_04.jpg); Qonto one dark CTA per card (qonto_04.jpg).
elements.what_it_does: Size, colour and shape make the one important action findable instantly, also for 45+ users.
elements.use_in_c: One primary per screen, 56 px, radius 14, leading icon, 17/700 label; press morphs radius 14→18 + scale .97 (quick spring); disabled = #C5CEDD, not faded ink. 'Befizettem' gets a check-in-circle icon.
elements.risk: Low.

elements.name: 20. Pull-to-refresh / progress as a pen wave
elements.seen_in: M3 Expressive wavy progress indicator and shape-morph loader (material_02.jpg).
elements.what_it_does: Brand-specific motion for waiting moments.
elements.use_in_c: Pulling Főoldal draws a short handwritten wave in white 60% on the band (pen-blue never on dark); while syncing NAV data it loops, then snaps into a tiny check. Upload progress uses the same wave filling left→right. Under 1 s where possible.
elements.risk: Medium: keep it subtle and short.

elements.name: 21. Large tabular numerals that roll
elements.seen_in: Revolut hero amounts '1 136 000 Ft' with '+19 060 Ft ▲ 3,16%' (revolut_hu_05.jpg), smaller decimals (revolut_05.jpg); Mercury superscript cents (mercury_1.jpg).
elements.what_it_does: The number is the hero and changes visibly when it changes.
elements.use_in_c: Keep Caslon Condensed 600 tnum 46-56 px on the band, 'Ft' at .5em #AEBBD2. When Bence recalculates, digits roll per column (odometer, 400 ms, 30 ms stagger) and a small line appears 'Bence frissítette, okt. 2.'. Thousands gap via CSS (fonts lack U+202F).
elements.risk: Low.

elements.name: 22. Upload pill '2/3' + ruled-line skeleton
elements.seen_in: Mercury 'Uploading Receipts… 1/3' pill (mercury_2.jpg); skeleton lists in Revolut/Qonto.
elements.what_it_does: Shows progress without blocking; loading looks like the final layout.
elements.use_in_c: Top pill 'Feltöltés… 2/3' with a thin progress line (tap = list). Loading letter: paper with faint ruled lines #EEF1F6 and a slow 1.2 s ink-fade shimmer instead of grey blocks; Dosszié rows = icon circle + two short lines.
elements.risk: Low.

elements.name: 23. Dark mode made of ink
elements.seen_in: Qonto dark mode for web and mobile on design tokens (qontodribbble_03.jpg); Revolut all-dark UI (revolut_03.jpg); Origin navy + serif (origin_1.jpg).
elements.what_it_does: Expected in 2026; reduces glare at night.
elements.use_in_c: Ground #0E1626, sheets #172238 (lighter than ground), band #17284A, text #E6EAF2, tonal button #24365C with #D6E0F0 label, done #7FC79A. The letter stays light #EEF1F6 so the pen-blue signature rule (white or #EEF1F6 only) still holds.
elements.risk: Medium: must stay navy, never #000 + neon (Revolut clone).

elements.name: 24. Subtle paper grain on the letter only
elements.seen_in: Not used by Revolut/Qonto; own proposal, mood from Monarch's warm paper tone and Origin's editorial serif (monarch_1.jpg, origin_1.jpg). Sample made on C's real letter: _minta_papirszemcse.jpg (left plain, right grain).
elements.what_it_does: Makes the letter read as paper among cards.
elements.use_in_c: 2-3% fibre texture only on the letter (SVG feTurbulence or an OpenRouter-generated seamless 512 px tile, cool white, darkening only below-mean fibres), not on ground or other sheets; off in high-contrast mode. Must disappear in the squint test.
elements.risk: Medium: cream + grain is a known AI tell; keep it cool white and barely visible.

elements.name: 25. Metallic 3D brand object (sparingly)
elements.seen_in: Revolut 2025 store art: chrome Bizum / MB WAY / currency objects inside a glass ring (revolut_13.jpg, revolut_14.jpg, revolut_15.jpg); Revolut Business 3D card (revolutbiz_01.jpg).
elements.what_it_does: Premium 'object' feel for brand moments.
elements.use_in_c: At most one object, e.g. an ink-blue enamel fountain-pen nib, generated via OpenRouter, only on the welcome screen / App Store art, never in daily screens.
elements.risk: High: Revolut's 2025 signature and the typical 'AI 3D' look; drop it if it fights the letter.

top_picks: 1. Bottom sheets (Revolut Business, iOS 26) for 'Hogyan jött ki?', the three transfers with 'Másolás', the 'Befizettem' confirmation and Bence's request; the letter stays visible behind.
2. Floating white pill tab bar (Főoldal, Dosszié, Üzenetek, Fiók) with a separate round ink-blue 'Fotózás' camera button (Revolut Business 2026, iOS 26 Liquid Glass), frosted white, no glass shine.

3. Deadline Live Activity + widget: 'NAV-befizetés 457 380 Ft, még 3 nap' on the lock screen with a line from letter date to deadline, 'Befizettem' in the expanded island (Apple Live Activities; Revolut 'Közelgő fizetés, 2 napon belül esedékes').

4. Document camera with edge-snapping corner brackets and auto-capture, followed by a 'Megkaptam' card: 'Nyugta, 18 000 Ft, az októberi bevételedhez került' + read-out field chips (Qonto scanner, Revolut Business 'Match found', Ramp).
5. Bence's review card with his real photo: 'Bence átnézte: 12 tétel, mind rendben' + KB monogram (Qonto 'Accountant Access, 148 entries verified').
6. 'Befizettem' moment: confirmation sheet, then an ink line strikes through the amount on the band, green 'Befizetve, okt. 9.', KB monogram stamp, success haptic. No confetti.
7. Signature draws itself (real pen order, ~900 ms) the first time each monthly letter opens; static afterwards (Revolut signature card + C's own stroke paths).

8. Round tonal quick actions under the letter: 'Fotózás, Feltöltés, Kérdezek, Igazolás' as 56 px #D6E0F0 circles with labels (Revolut, Qonto). This fixes the 'buttons blend in' complaint. Runners-up: pen-hatched 'várható' part on the limit meter (Qonto) and pen-drawn empty states generated on OpenRouter (Qonto illustrations).
